thread:
Margo: heads-up: product wants autoswitch fallback enabled for rollout-v2 tomorrow. quick UX question: how do we keep operator audit noise low but keep traceability?
Ibrahim: I'd split signals: (1) lightweight digest for the console (counts + top reason), (2) full audit rows only when operator overrides or on sampled decisions.
Kayla: agree. propose front-loaded sampling window: 12m @ 20% then exponential decay to 0.5% over 24h. we capture early instability without forever noise.
Noah: For the digest, show top-2 reasons and a small sparkline of fallback rate. clicking the digest opens sampled traces.
Frida: reason taxonomy: don't use opaque codes. add enum reasons: latency_p95, upstream_5xx, quota_limit, model_infer_err, cold_start.
Margo: nice. also need clear labels for degrade modes: trial, soft, forced. show as pill: `trial  latency_p95` with fallback percent.
Ibrahim: operator controls: quick snooze (5m/30m/2h) + a persistent hold (stick) override. stick requires a short rationale and creates an immutable audit event.
Kayla: UI placement: snooze action on rollout header; stick override in operator flyout. when stick is active show orange badge and tooltip with actor + TTL.
Noah: protect against flip-flopping: per-rollout stick cooldowns: 0 -> 5m -> 30m -> 2h -> 8h. each stick increments cooldown and is recorded.
Frida: telemetry fields to record on decision event: decision_id, rollout_id, ts, fallback_reason, degrade_mode, sampled, override_action, override_actor, override_note, prev_policy_rev, prev_route, fallback_variant.
Margo: docs should include a console snippet for customers. small example we agreed on:
```
fallback_policy:
  mode: trial
  triggers: [latency_p95, upstream_5xx]
  sampling:
    initial_pct: 0.2
    decay: exponential
    min_pct: 0.005
  operator:
    snooze: [300, 1800, 7200]
    require_hold_note: true
```
Ibrahim: note: sampled decisions should carry a pointer to the trace id so clicking the digest opens the relevant span. linkability is key.
Kayla: also add a compact "why" text for each sampled entry: e.g. "latency_p95 exceeded 800ms (p95: 920ms)" so operators get context without digging logs.
Noah: for queries, save a console quicksearch: `events | where rollout_id=="<id>" and decision=="fallback" | summarize count() by fallback_reason, override_action`
Frida: audit retention: full override rows kept 2y, sampled decisions kept 90d by default. include retention in docs.
ops-bot: Deploy note: rollout-v2-autoswitch planned by @Margo at 1766182100. monitoring teams auto-subscribed.
Margo: action items: Kayla mock digest + badge; Ibrahim add sampling + trace links; Frida update telemetry schema & retention; Noah add cooldown enforcement in operator service. I'll gate flip until we have mocks.
Kayla: Figma mock by EOD, will include hover states for pill and badge.
Ibrahim: PR for sampling logic + tests by 4pm.
Frida: schema diff and migration steps by afternoon.
Noah: infra ticket for cooldown and audit plumbing open now.
Margo: if mocks look good we enable tomorrow. if not, we delay. any objections?
Kayla: no objections.
Ibrahim: none.
Frida: good with the plan.
Noah: all good.
Margo: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
